prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: GREYLINE game, single transparent whole-body animation sprite sheet.
Input image 1 is a COSTUME, LAUNCHER DESIGN, AND PAINTED ART STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Use its olive/tan modern infantry kit, helmet, dark boots, pouches, and compact wooden-stock, short thick dark-barrel break-action grenade launcher. Create a NEW prone-only sheet; do not reproduce the old atlas, standing poses, kneeling poses, or its layout.

OUTPUT: Exactly ONE RGBA PNG with genuine transparent alpha background, preferably 2048 x 1536 pixels (landscape), with exactly EIGHT animation cels arranged in TWO COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS of equal rectangular cells. Reading order is left-to-right, top-to-bottom. No drawn borders, text, numbers, annotations, diagrams, checkerboard background, or ground. These are visual game animation cels, not an instructional diagram.

SUBJECT AND STYLE: In every cel show the SAME single adult infantryman PRONE facing RIGHT in a consistent side-profile camera. Entire figure from both boots at left to the launcher muzzle at right, fully visible inside its own cell. Detailed painted realistic game art matching the reference's textured muted olive/tan uniform, helmet, webbing, dark gloves/boots and wooden stock. Realistic adult anatomy and proportions. Natural material shading confined to the figure, no cast shadows. Exactly two arms and two legs, no extra or ghosted limbs or duplicated bodies.

REGISTRATION AND SPACING: Keep camera, scale, uniform, equipment, body length, hip anchor and boot anchors consistent throughout all eight cels. Wide, low prone silhouettes with ample fully transparent gutters on all sides. In each equal cell, reserve at least 6% width on each side and 15% height top/bottom; every boot, elbow, hand, body part and barrel must remain inside these margins. Use the same invisible ground baseline at about 76% of cell height for every cel. Pelvis, knees, and extended legs stay flat at that baseline, chest rests low on elbows/forearms, only subtle head/shoulder movement. No sitting up, kneeling, crouching, raised pelvis, changing leg pose or shortening body. Keep all equipment above the invisible baseline. The muzzle must NEVER point downward below the ground line. For the open-breech poses, rotate the compact launcher gently SIDEWAYS and lift it slightly on the supporting forearm so the opening is readable while the entire barrel stays above the baseline. Do not swing the barrel down into the ground.

EIGHT SEQUENTIAL CELS, in row-major order:
Row 1 left / cel 1: low aimed ready prone silhouette, stock at shoulder, short barrel pointed right slightly ABOVE horizontal.
Row 1 right / cel 2: small fired recoil, subtle shoulder/launcher movement, no flash, no smoke; hips and boots remain registered.
Row 2 left / cel 3: launcher gently rolled sideways and raised a little, visibly open break-action breech, supported on forearm, entire launcher above the baseline.
Row 2 right / cel 4: same open launcher support, free hand reaches back near a waist pouch to retrieve a round; torso stays low.
Row 3 left / cel 5: free hand carries one clearly visible SQUAT grenade round toward the open breech; keep round visibly distinct from the hand and launcher.
Row 3 right / cel 6: round is seated in the open breech, hand finishing the load; distinct hand pose from cel 5.
Row 4 left / cel 7: hand closes the launcher, weapon still low, body and leg anchors unchanged.
Row 4 right / cel 8: return to the EXACT initial aimed prone silhouette of cel 1, same head, limbs, launcher angle, hips and boots, for a seamless loop.

Launcher identity must remain a compact wooden-stock break-action grenade launcher in every cel, as in the reference. No RPG, rocket tube, rocket, long rifle, rifle magazine, or magazine-changing action. No floor, terrain, props, cast shadows, flames, muzzle flash, smoke, speed lines, outlines of other poses, spare limbs, labels, logos or watermark. All empty space is actually transparent; never paint an opaque background or a simulated transparency pattern. Prioritize eight complete unclipped figures, registered prone anchors, distinct requested hand/launcher poses, and clear transparent gutters.
